uniform_temporal_subsample_video: create a UniformTemporalSubsample transform to select equispaced temporal samples from a video tensor
short_side_scale_video: build a ShortSideScale transform to resize a video tensor by scaling its short side to a target size
random_resized_crop_video: create a RandomResizedCrop transform to randomly crop and resize a video tensor to target dimensions
normalize_video_clip: build a Normalize transform to normalize a video tensor by mean subtraction and standard deviation division
op_sampler_transforms: create an OpSampler to randomly sample and apply weighted transforms sequentially to an input tensor
